in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Hukill in Hebrew is derived from the Hebrew word 'chokel' which means 'strong one'. It is a masculine name, suggesting power and strength.

in_greek.name: Ὑγκίλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hukill in Greek is derived from the Greek word 'hugkillos' which means 'strength'. This name was commonly used in the Greek Bible and was borne by several early Christian saints.

in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hukill in Latin is derived from the Latin word 'hucillus' which means 'strong one'. It was used in the Latin Vulgate and by early Christian writers.
